title: Duckling dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="30" ry="7" fill="#1c2b4a"/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <path d="M42 72 L36 84 L30 84" stroke="#f39c12" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M30 84 L24 88 M30 84 L30 90 M30 84 L36 88" stroke="#f7b731" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- right leg kicked out -->
  <path d="M58 72 L66 80 L74 78" stroke="#f39c12" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M74 78 L80 80 M74 78 L76 84 M74 78 L70 83" stroke="#f7b731" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="18" ry="12" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="60" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#ffe97a" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- left wing raised up dancing -->
  <path d="M28 56 Q14 40 22 28" stroke="#f7b731" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M22 28 L16 22 M22 28 L28 20 M22 28 L20 18" stroke="#ffd93d" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- right wing raised other way -->
  <path d="M72 56 Q86 42 80 30" stroke="#f7b731" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M80 30 L86 24 M80 30 L86 32 M80 30 L82 20" stroke="#ffd93d" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="16" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="30" r="9" fill="#ffe97a" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- eyes (happy closed dancing) -->
  <path d="M41 32 Q44 28 47 32" stroke="#1c2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M55 32 Q58 28 61 32" stroke="#1c2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="38" r="3.5" fill="#ff9f43" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="38" r="3.5" fill="#ff9f43" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- beak -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ff9f43"/>
  <path d="M43 42 Q50 48 57 42" fill="#e67e22"/>
  
  <!-- little tuft on head -->
  <path d="M50 18 Q48 12 52 10 Q54 14 50 18" fill="#f7b731"/>
  <path d="M50 18 Q55 10 60 12 Q56 16 50 18" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  
  <!-- music notes floating -->
  <g fill="#4ecdc4">
    <path d="M18 14 L18 24 Q16 28 14 27 Q12 26 14 24 Q15 23 18 24 L18 14 L24 12 L24 22 Q22 26 20 25 Q18 24 20 22 Q21 21 24 22 L24 12 Z" opacity="0.9"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#ff6b6b">
    <path d="M78 10 L78 18 Q76 21 75 20 Q73 19 75 17 Q76 16 78 17 L78 10 L82 9 L82 17 Q80 20 79 19 Q77 18 79 16 Q80 15 82 16 L82 9 Z"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#a55eea">
    <circle cx="14" cy="46" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="86" cy="50" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="62" r="1.8"/>
  </g>
</svg>
